Hasta que en una de ellas, se me acercó y me dijo
con voz nerviosa: 'Creo que estoy enamorada de ti.'

Original:
I felt an unexplainable joy in my body that
whole day.
en:
I felt an unexplainable joy in my body that
whole day.
es-latam:
Sentí... una enorme felicidad aquel día, una
que me cuesta describir con palabras.

Original:
It was special, unlike anything I had ever felt
before.
en:
It was special, unlike anything I had ever felt
before.
es-latam:
Nunca había sentido nada siquiera parecido
con eso.

Original:
Sometimes, we would hang out at random spots
and listen to music together.
en:
Sometimes, we would hang out at random spots
and listen to music together.
es-latam:
A veces, nos la pasábamos escuchando música aquí
y allá, ella con un audífono y yo con el otro.

Original: I'd share an earbud, and we would enjoy the view.
en: I'd share an earbud, and we would enjoy the view.
es-latam:
Solos, imperturbables, ajenos a nuestra realidad...
contemplando el ocaso del día.

Original:
She had introduced me to this one artist, and I
started listening to their music all the time.
en:
She had introduced me to this one artist, and I
started listening to their music all the time.
es-latam:
Ella me mostró uno de sus artistas favoritos, y yo,
como era obvio, comenze a escucharlo todo los días.

Original:
Every time I listened to them, I thought
about Haven.
en:
Every time I listened to them, I thought
about Haven.
es-latam: Cada vez que lo escuchaba, pensaba en ella.

Original: How beautiful she was, how caring she could be ...
en: How beautiful she was, how caring she could be ...
es-latam:
Pensaba en lo hermosa que era, así como
en lo amable y cariñosa que era conmigo.

Original:
She was my everything.\!
I couldn't stop thinking about her.
en:
She was my everything.\!
I couldn't stop thinking about her.
es-latam:
Ella era mi mundo.\!
Significaba todo para mí.

Original: I was so happy.
en: I was so happy.
es-latam: Me sentía tan feliz.

Name: Haven
Original: Hey, do you wanna try something?
en: Hey, do you wanna try something?
es-latam: Oye, ¿quieres pobar algo?

Original: What do you mean?
en: What do you mean?
es-latam: ¿Como qué?

Name: Haven
Original: Hold on ...
en: Hold on ...
es-latam: Dame un momentito...

Original: What's that?
en: What's that?
es-latam: ¿Qué es eso?

Name: Haven
Original:
It's a grinder.\!
It's used to grind up weed.
en:
It's a grinder.\!
It's used to grind up weed.
es-latam:
Es un grinder. Algunos también lo llaman 'moledor'.\!
Se usa para triturar 'hierba'. Me entiendes, ¿no?

Name: Haven
Original:
I understand if it's not your thing, but if you
wanna try it out...
en:
I understand if it's not your thing, but if you
wanna try it out ...
es-latam:
Pero no te voy a obligarte ni nada
parecido...

Name: Haven
Original: It's your choice!
en: It's your choice!
es-latam: Es tu decición.

Original:
I knew Haven had been smoking for a little while,
but I had never seen her high.
en:
I knew Haven had been smoking for a little while,
but I had never seen her high.
es-latam:
Hacía un tiempo que sabía que Haven fumaba,
pero nunca la había visto bajo los efectos.

Original:
It felt a bit strange when she first mentioned it,
I couldn't imagine her being that kind of person.
en:
It felt a bit strange when she first mentioned it,
I couldn't imagine her being that kind of person.
es-latam:
Me sentí algo raro cuando mencionó el tema, nunca
imaginé que fuera de aquellos.

Original: I decided to try it out for the first time.
en: I decided to try it out for the first time.
es-latam: Aún así, decidi darle una oportunidad.

Original: It felt special.
en: It felt special.
es-latam: Se sentía... especial, único.

Original:
All the worries I had weren't important anymore,
and I appreciated this moment we shared.
en:
All the worries I had weren't important anymore,
and I appreciated this moment we shared.
es-latam:
Todas mis preocupaciones comenzaron a desvanecerse
en una espiral de placer.

Original:
I could feel everything at once,\. and nothing
at the same time.
en:
I could feel everything at once,\. and nothing
at the same time.
es-latam: Podía sentirlo todo\. y a la vez, nada.

Original:
I was so thankful to have Haven in my life now.\!
She had become a part of me.
en:
I was so thankful to have Haven in my life now.\!
She had become a part of me.
es-latam:
Estaba tan agradecido de compartir ese momento
juntos, y más aún, de tenerla en mi vida.

Name: Haven
Original: I do miss these moments with you.
en: I do miss these moments with you.
es-latam: Extraño mucho esos buenos momentos que pasamos.

Name: Haven
Original: They felt magical, didn’t they?
en: They felt magical, didn’t they?
es-latam: Eran, en cierta forma, mágicos.

Name: Haven
Original: We were both so happy with each other ...
en: We were both so happy with each other ...
es-latam: Éramos tan felices.

Original: It's a black jacket.
en: It's a black jacket.
es-latam: Es una chaqueta negra.

Name: Haven
Original:
I was truly happy for a while.
You brought out something in me.
en:
I was truly happy for a while.
You brought out something in me.
es-latam:
Por un tiempo, llegue a sentirme muy feliz contigo.
Descubrí una faceta que no conocía de mí.

Name: Haven
Original:
That childlike quality, that curiosity...\.
I don't really know what it was, but it felt new.
en:
That childlike quality, that curiosity ...\.
I don't really know what it was, but it felt new.
es-latam:
Esa inocencia, esa... curiosidad...\.
No sé muy bien lo que era, pero se sentía diiferente.

Name: Haven
Original:
I had already told all my friends about you, and
how much I enjoyed spending my time with you!
en:
I had already told all my friends about you, and
how much I enjoyed spending my time with you!
es-latam:
Les he contado a todos mis amigos sobre ti y lo
mucho que adoro pasar tiempo contigo.

Name: Haven
Original: I couldn’t wait for you to meet them!
en: I couldn’t wait for you to meet them!
es-latam: ¡Estoy deseosa de que los conoscas!

Original: Hang the jacket on the coat hanger?
en: Hang the jacket on the coat hanger?
es-latam: ¿Colgar la chaqueta?

Original: Hanging the jacket brings back a familiar feeling.
en: Hanging the jacket brings back a familiar feeling.
es-latam: Esa acción te resulta familiar.

Original:
Haven invited me to join her at a party.\! She said
it's a nice opportunity to meet her friends.
en:
Haven invited me to join her at a party.\! She said
it's a nice opportunity to meet her friends.
es-latam:
Haven me había invitado a su fiesta.\! Dijo que
era una oportunidad única de conocer a sus amigos.

Original:
I picked out a nice black suit, hoping it wasn’t
too fancy for the party.
en:
I picked out a nice black suit, hoping it wasn’t
too fancy for the party.
es-latam:
Me puse una traje negro — esperaba que no
pareciera demasiado formal.

Original:
I'm not known for being the most outgoing person.\!
I've never been to a party before.
en:
I'm not known for being the most outgoing person.\!
I've never been to a party before.
es-latam:
Estoy lejos de ser una persona extrovertida.\!
Y nunca he estado en una fiesta.

Original: It'll be fine, right?
en: It'll be fine, right?
es-latam: Todo estará bien, ¿verdad?

Original: I'll try my best.
en: I'll try my best.
es-latam: Voy a intentarlo.

Original: It won't be that bad, right?
en: It won't be that bad, right?
es-latam: No puede ser tan malo.

Original:
Besides, we had a couple of dates now, and
they’ve all been great.
en:
Besides, we had a couple of dates now, and
they’ve all been great.
es-latam:
Además, estoy seguro que son buenas
personas.

Original: I'm sure it'll be fine.
en: I'm sure it'll be fine.
es-latam: Todo va a salir bien.

Original: It's a coat hanger with a jacket on it.
en: It's a coat hanger with a jacket on it.
es-latam: Es una chaqueta colgada en un gancho.

Original: It's a stool with a drink on it.
en: It's a stool with a drink on it.
es-latam: Es un banquito con una bebida encima.

Original: Sit on the stool?
en: Sit on the stool?
es-latam: ¿Sentarse?

Original: You try to remember something ...
en: You try to remember something ...
es-latam: Tratas de recordar...

Original: This didn't feel right.
en: This didn't feel right.
es-latam: Esto no va bien.

Original:
The music was so loud, I couldn't hear myself
think.
en:
The music was so loud, I couldn't hear myself
think.
es-latam:
La música era demasiado alta, ni siquiera
podía pensar.

Original:
There were so many people I didn't know, it felt
like I was being watched.
en:
There were so many people I didn't know, it felt
like I was being watched.
es-latam:
Estaba rodeado de extraños. Sentía como si me
estuvieran vigilando.

Original: And Haven ...
en: And Haven ...
es-latam: Y Haven...

Original:
She kept talking with her friends.\!
Her world is so much bigger than mine.
en:
She kept talking with her friends.\!
Her world is so much bigger than mine.
es-latam:
Ella paraba hablando con sus amigos.\!
Pertenecemos a dos mundos tan diferentes.

Original: ...\. She didn't forget about me, \.right?
en: ...\. She didn't forget about me, \.right?
es-latam: ...\. Ella no se ha olvidado de mí, \.¿verdad?

Original:
It's okay ...\!
She's just talking to her friends ...
en:
It's okay ...\!
She's just talking to her friends ...
es-latam:
Vamos, no es para tanto...\!
Solo está conversando con sus amigos...

Original:
You can't have all her attention ...\!
It's not about you ...
en:
You can't have all her attention ...\!
It's not about you ...
es-latam:
Sería raro si solo hablara contigo...\!
Trata de entenderla...

Original: I should go out for a smoke.
en: I should go out for a smoke.
es-latam: Tal vez debería salir un rato a fumar.

Original: Just to help me calm down.
en: Just to help me calm down.
es-latam: Eso me hará sentir mejor.

Original:
The air felt cold outside.\!
The cigarette did help me slow down.
en:
The air felt cold outside.\!
The cigarette did help me slow down.
es-latam:
Hacía mucho frío afuera,\!
pero eso me ayudó a relajarme un poco.

Original: But just thinking about her ...
en: But just thinking about her ...
es-latam: Aunque cada vez que volvía a pensar en ella...

Original: ...\. Why does it slightly hurt?
en: ...\. Why does it slightly hurt?
es-latam: ...\. Me sentía un poco dolido.

Original:
I shouldn't be feeling sad.\!
I still love Haven and she loves me.
en:
I shouldn't be feeling sad.\!
I still love Haven and she loves me.
es-latam:
¿Por qué te estás sintiendo así?\!
Tú la amas y ella te ama también.

Original: Why do I feel like this?
en: Why do I feel like this?
es-latam: ¿No te basta con eso?

Original:
Nothing even happened, and yet I feel betrayed
by her.
en:
Nothing even happened, and yet I feel betrayed
by her.
es-latam:
Ella no había hecho anda malo, y aún así, me
sentía traicionado.

Original: ...\. This isn't safe.
en: ...\. This isn't safe.
es-latam: ...\. No, esto no va bien.

Original: I don't feel comfortable.
en: I don't feel comfortable.
es-latam: Me está afectando...

Original: I have to go away.
en: I have to go away.
es-latam: Tengo que salir de aquí.

Original: This isn't good.
en: This isn't good.
es-latam: No está bien, no está bien...

Original: Why am I thinking like this?
en: Why am I thinking like this?
es-latam: ¿Por qué tengo estos pensamientos?

Original: Why am I running away?
en: Why am I running away?
es-latam: ¿Por qué estoy huyendo?

Original:
I need to calm down again.\!
I'll just sit here for a while.
en:
I need to calm down again.\!
I'll just sit here for a while.
es-latam:
Primero calmate,\! ahora sientate y trata
de respirar profundamente.

Original:
It's ...\. okay ... \!
It'll be ...\. okay ...
en:
It's ...\. okay ... \!
It'll be ...\. okay ...
es-latam:
Respira...\. respira...\!
Todo...\. estará bien...

Original: I shouldn't be freaking out ...
en: I shouldn't be freaking out ...
es-latam: No tienes por qué ponerte así...

Original: Why does this hurt so much ...
en: Why does this hurt so much ...
es-latam: Pero es que duele tanto...

Original:
Just ...\. calm ..\.. down ...\!
Please ...
en:
Just ...\. calm ...\. down ...\!
Please ...
es-latam:
Tranquilízate...\. por favor...\!
Por favor...

Original: CALM ...\. DOWN ...
en: CALM ...\. DOWN ...
es-latam: ¡TE LO ESTOY PIDIENDO...!

Original: STOP IT ...
en: STOP IT ...
es-latam: ¡POR FAVOR...!

Original: I CAN'T THINK ...
en: I CAN'T THINK ...
es-latam: NO PUEDO PENSAR...

Original: I CAN'T\^
en: I CAN'T\^
es-latam: NO PUEDO\^

Original: I see someone in front of me.
en: I see someone in front of me.
es-latam: Vi a alguien parado frente a mí.

Original: I catch my breath, and slowly look up.
en: I catch my breath, and slowly look up.
es-latam: Todavía jadeando, trato de ver de quién se trata.

Name: Haven
Original: Are you okay?
en: Are you okay?
es-latam: ¿Estás bien?

Original: I'm fine.
en: I'm fine.
es-latam: Sí, está todo bien.

Original: I just needed some fresh air.
en: I just needed some fresh air.
es-latam: Solo... necesitaba un poco de aire fresco.

Name: Haven
Original: Are you sure?
en: Are you sure?
es-latam: ¿Solo eso? ¿Estás seguro?

Name: Haven
Original:
I'll be back inside.\!
You should come too.
en:
I'll be back inside.\!
You should come too.
es-latam:
Voy a volver adentro.\!
¿Por qué no me acompañas?

Original: I'll be there in a second.
en: I'll be there in a second.
es-latam: Sí, voy en un momento.

Original: She doesn't care about me.
en: She doesn't care about me.
es-latam: No le importo.

Original: She would have stayed here if she did.
en: She would have stayed here if she did.
es-latam:
Ella se hubiera quedado aquí si lo
hiciera.

Original: I should leave.
en: I should leave.
es-latam: Es mejor que me vaya.

Original: I can try to break the shadow with this rock ...
en: I can try to break the shadow with this rock ...
es-latam: Puedo tratar de quebrar la sombra con esta piedra...

Original: Break
en: Break
es-latam: Quebrar

Original: You throw away the rock.
en: You throw away the rock.
es-latam: Tiras la piedra.

Original: The shadow is too hard to remove.
en: The shadow is too hard to remove.
es-latam: La sombra es demasiado difícil de quitar.

Name: Haven
Original: Why did you leave the party?
en: Why did you leave the party?
es-latam: ¿Por qué te fuiste?

Name: Haven
Original: I was so worried about you ...
en: I was so worried about you ...
es-latam: Me dejaste tan preocupada...

Original: I say nothing.
en: I say nothing.
es-latam: Me quedo callado.

Original: She doesn't deserve to hear anything from me.
en: She doesn't deserve to hear anything from me.
es-latam: No merece siquiera que le dirija la palabra.

Original: I was expecting her to say she's sorry.
en: I was expecting her to say she's sorry.
es-latam: No sin antes disculparse conmigo.

Original: ... But she had no reason to apologize.
en: ... But she had no reason to apologize.
es-latam: ... Pero no tiene por qué hacerlo.

Original: It's not her fault.
en: It's not her fault.
es-latam: No fue su culpa.

Original: Why did I act like that?
en: Why did I act like that?
es-latam: ¿Por qué me estoy portando así con ella?

Original:
If I say something, she’ll probably think I’m
being dramatic.
en:
If I say something, she’ll probably think I’m
being dramatic.
es-latam:
Si digo algo, probablemente piense que estoy
exagerando.

Original:
She’ll forget about it soon enough, and things
will go back to normal.
en:
She’ll forget about it soon enough, and things
will go back to normal.
es-latam:
Tal vez no es para tanto. Dentro de poco ella
lo olvidará y todo volverá a la normalidad.

Original: Except things never went back to normal.
en: Except things never went back to normal.
es-latam:
O al menos, eso es lo que me hubiera gustado
que pasara.

Original: It's a bed.
en: It's a bed.
es-latam: Es una cama.

Original:
You can barely make out a lighter on the table.\.
Grab the lighter?
en:
You can barely make out a lighter on the table.\.
Grab the lighter?
es-latam:
Logras distinguir un encendedor en la cama.\.
¿Agarrarlo?

Original:
You think about how many times you've lit a lighter
in your life.
en:
You think about how many times you've lit a lighter
in your life.
es-latam:
Te pones a pensar en todas veces que lo usaste para
encender un cigarrillo.

Original: How many times you'd smoke alone.
en: How many times you'd smoke alone.
es-latam: En todas y cada una de ellas.

Original:
We stopped getting in touch with each other
after a few weeks.
en:
We stopped getting in touch with each other
after a few weeks.
es-latam: Paramos de hablarnos luego de algunas semanas.

Original:
I can’t forget that last message she sent.\!
"I hope you’ll be doing okay"
en:
I can’t forget that last message she sent.\!
"I hope you’ll be doing okay"
es-latam:
Nunca olvidaré su último mensaje.\!
"Espero que te esté yendo bien."

Original:
For weeks, I was wondering if she was going to
send something, but that never happened.
en:
For weeks, I was wondering if she was going to
send something, but that never happened.
es-latam:
Pasé semanas esperando que mandara algún otro
mensaje... nunca lo hizo.

Original:
I didn’t respond to her.\. I was too scared.\!
She was probably mad at me.
en:
I didn’t respond to her.\. I was too scared.\!
She was probably mad at me.
es-latam:
Yo tenía tanto miedo...\. de contestarle.\!
Seguro que estaba enfadada conmigo.

Original:
I'd smoke every day just so I wouldn't have to
think about her.
en:
I'd smoke every day just so I wouldn't have to
think about her.
es-latam:
Fumaba todos los días para tratar de sacarla
de mi cabeza.

Original:
Because everytime I would, I'd get sad, confused,
and mad.
en:
Because everytime I would, I'd get sad, confused,
and mad.
es-latam:
Porque cada vez que pensaba en ella, me sentía
lleno de angustia y frustrado.

Original: These emotions would take control of me.
en: These emotions would take control of me.
es-latam: Dejé que mis emociones me controlaran.

Original:
I knew what I was doing wasn't right, but it 
didn't feel fair.
en:
I knew what I was doing wasn't right, but it 
didn't feel fair.
es-latam:
Sabía que lo que hacía no estaba bien, pero
me negaba a aceptarlo. No era justo.

Original: It became an addiction, fueling my distraction.
en: It became an addiction, fueling my distraction.
es-latam: Pronto se volvio una obsesión.

Original: I started having trouble sleeping.
en: I started having trouble sleeping.
es-latam:
Su recuerdo empezó a perseguirme incluso
en los sueños.

Original:
She'd appear in my dreams, and it felt like all
my progress was gone.
en:
She'd appear in my dreams, and it felt like all
my progress was gone.
es-latam:
Y todo el esfuerzo que había hecho para tratar
de olvidarla se volvía inútil.

Original: I just wanted to stop thinking about her.
en: I just wanted to stop thinking about her.
es-latam: Era incapaz de borrarla de mi mente.

Original: What does she even mean to me?
en: What does she even mean to me?
es-latam: ¿Qué era ella para mí?

Original:
She felt safe.\!
She felt warm.
en:
She felt safe.\!
She felt warm.
es-latam:
Ella era tranquilidad.\!
Era calidez.

Original:
She was optimistic.\!
She was herself.
en:
She was optimistic.\!
She was herself.
es-latam:
Era tan entusiasta.\!
Era ella misma.

Original: Just being around her was enough for me.
en: Just being around her was enough for me.
es-latam: Tan solo estar a su lado era suficiente para mí.

Original:
Even though this relationship probably didn’t mean
much to her.
en:
Even though this relationship probably didn’t mean
much to her.
es-latam:
Incluso aunque nuestra relación no sifnificase
mucho para ella.

Original: What was I to her?
en: What was I to her?
es-latam: ¿Qué era yo para ella?

Original: I wouldn't know.
en: I wouldn't know.
es-latam: No lo sé.

Original:
I don't understand why she even spoke to me in
the first place.
en:
I don't understand why she even spoke to me in
the first place.
es-latam:
Ni siquiera sé por qué se acerco a hablarme
aquella vez.

Original:
Maybe it didn't matter who it was, she was just
lonely.
en:
Maybe it didn't matter who it was, she was just
lonely.
es-latam:
Tal vez quería hablar con alguien para no
sentirse tan sola en ese momento.

Original: And that loneliness cut through me.
en: And that loneliness cut through me.
es-latam:
Y ahora que no está, empiezo a sentir
esa misma soledad.

Original:
It left me with a scar that would never
completely heal.
en:
It left me with a scar that would never
completely heal.
es-latam: Desearía que estubiera aquí conmigo.

Original:
I wish she was someone who would always be
there for me.
en:
I wish she was someone who would always be
there for me.
es-latam: Ella era mi mundo...

Original: A safe haven.
en: A safe haven.
es-latam: ¿Qué será de mí ahora?

Original: There's a lighter on the table.
en: There's a lighter on the table.
es-latam: Hay un encendedor en la mesa.

Original: I don't need it.
en: I don't need it.
es-latam: No lo necesito.

Name: Haven
Original:
Do you remember that time we climbed a
mountain?
en:
Do you remember that time we climbed a
mountain?
es-latam:
¿Recuerdas la última vez que escalamos
una montaña?

Name: Haven
Original:
It was my idea for a date, since I loved
climbing as a child.
en:
It was my idea for a date, since I loved
climbing as a child.
es-latam:
Fue idea mía, claro. Es algo que hacía
desde pequeña, y me encantaba.

Name: Haven
Original: It took us the whole day, but the view was great.
en: It took us the whole day, but the view was great.
es-latam:
Nos tomó todo el día, pero contemplar
aquella vista... valió todo el esfuerzo.

Name: Haven
Original: We placed a flag on the top, to show we made it.
en: We placed a flag on the top, to show we made it.
es-latam:
Pusimos una bandera en la cima, para
mostrar al mundo nuestra hazaña.

Name: Haven
Original: It was beautiful,\. wasn’t it?
en: It was beautiful,\. wasn’t it?
es-latam: Fue tan hermoso,\. ¿no lo crees?

Name: Haven
Original: I still don’t get why you couldn’t let go.
en: I still don’t get why you couldn’t let go.
es-latam:
Aún no entiendo por qué es que te
aferraste tanto.

Name: Haven
Original: You didn’t have much in your life.
en: You didn’t have much in your life.
es-latam: Tu vida se sentía algo vacía.

Name: Haven
Original: I do miss you.
en: I do miss you.
es-latam: Aún te extraño. Deberías saberlo.

Name: Haven
Original: You were important to me too.
en: You were important to me too.
es-latam: Fuiste alguien muy importante para mí.

Name: Haven
Original:
You should have sent a message.\|
I know you wanted to talk about it.
en:
You should have sent a message.\|
I know you wanted to talk about it.
es-latam:
Debiste haber respondido mi mensaje.\|
Sé que dentro de ti querías decirme algo.

Name: Haven
Original: And yet, you never sent anything.
en: And yet, you never sent anything.
es-latam: Pero nunca te animaste a hacerlo.

Name: Haven
Original:
I was going to send something, but I thought you
needed space.
en:
I was going to send something, but I thought you
needed space.
es-latam:
Por un momento, quise tomar la iniciativa, pero
recapacité y decidí darte tu espacio.

Name: Haven
Original:
You probably needed some time after what
happened at the party.
en:
You probably needed some time after what
happened at the party.
es-latam:
Pensé que necesitabas darte un tiempo
después de lo que ocurrió en la fiesta.

Name: Haven
Original: You’ve been breaking yourself.
en: You’ve been breaking yourself.
es-latam: Te has estado amargando la vida.

Name: Haven
Original: You’re unstable.
en: You’re unstable.
es-latam: Eres muy inestable.

Original: I want to move on
en: I want to move on
es-latam: Quiero superarlo

Original: I don’t miss you
en: I don’t miss you
es-latam: No te extraño

Original: I do want to move on.
en: I do want to move on.
es-latam:
Quiero superarlo, seguir adelante...
no quedarme estancado en el pasado.

Original: I truly do.
en: I truly do.
es-latam: En verdad quiero.

Original: I've tried so hard to just get you out of my mind.
en: I've tried so hard to just get you out of my mind.
es-latam: Traté como pude de borrarte de mi mente.

Original: I can't have a day where I don't miss you.
en: I can't have a day where I don't miss you.
es-latam: Pero no pasa un día sin que sienta falta de ti.

Original:
I'd look back on old photos, songs we used to
listen to together.
en:
I'd look back on old photos, songs we used to
listen to together.
es-latam:
Cada vez que me encuentro viendo nuestras
viejas fotos...

Original:
And I know that we can't make any more of these
memories.
en:
And I know that we can't make any more of these
memories.
es-latam:
O escuchando las canciones que tanto nos
gustaban...

Original: It just makes me so sad.
en: It just makes me so sad.
es-latam:
Empiezo a sentir... un apretón en el corazón...
al saber que esos momentos ya no volverán.

Original: I miss you, Haven.
en: I miss you, Haven.
es-latam: Te extraño Haven. Te extraño mucho.

Original: I don't think I was ready for a relationship.
en: I don't think I was ready for a relationship.
es-latam:
No estaba listo para tener una relación
de pareja.

Original:
I'm unstable.\|
That's just how I am.
en:
I'm unstable.\|
That's just how I am.
es-latam:
Soy inestable.\|
Así soy yo.

Original:
I hoped that after years, I'd finally move on.\!
It just feels impossible.
en:
I hoped that after years, I'd finally move on.\!
It just feels impossible.
es-latam:
Quisiera poder decirte que depués de tantos años\!
por fin dejé de aferrarme a tu recuerdo...

Original:
I'm obsessed.\!
You've planted yourself into my brain.
en:
I'm obsessed.\!
You've planted yourself into my brain.
es-latam:
Pero no puedo...\! No puedo
sacarte de mi mente... es como una obsesión.

Original: ...\. No, I have.
en: ...\. No, I have.
es-latam: ...\. Lo he intentado tantas veces.

Original:
I told myself that if I let go, it would mean
none of it mattered.
en:
I told myself that if I let go, it would mean
none of it mattered.
es-latam:
Pero no podía dejar de sentir que, si lo hacía,
entonces todo lo que vivimos habría sido en vano.

Original: That you didn’t matter.
en: That you didn’t matter.
es-latam: Y una parte de mí aún cree que no lo fue.

Original: But moving on doesn’t mean forgetting.
en: But moving on doesn’t mean forgetting.
es-latam: Pero superar a alguien no significa olvidar...

Original: It means letting go.
en: It means letting go.
es-latam:
Significa hacer las paces con su recuerdo y
seguir adelante.

Original: You’ll always be a part of me, Haven.
en: You’ll always be a part of me, Haven.
es-latam:
Siempre tendrás un lugar especial en mi
corazón, Haven.

Original: But I can’t let you be all of me.
en: But I can’t let you be all of me.
es-latam:
Pero no puedo dejar que te adueñes completamente
de él.

Original:
My chest starts to feel lighter.\!
It's like a weight has been removed.
en:
My chest starts to feel lighter.\!
It's like a weight has been removed.
es-latam:
Siento el pecho más ligero, descontraído...\!
como si me hubiesen quitado un gran peso de encima.

Original: I don't miss you.
en: I don't miss you.
es-latam: No te extraño.

Original: I just can’t keep living like this.
en: I just can’t keep living like this.
es-latam: No puedo seguir viviendo así.

Original:
Thinking about you every day,\. looking through
old messages,\. thinking about the past.
en:
Thinking about you every day,\. looking through
old messages,\. thinking about the past.
es-latam:
Pienso en ti cada día,\. reviso nuestros viejos
mensajes,\. te veo en mis sueños...

Original: I keep telling myself that I just need time.
en: I keep telling myself that I just need time.
es-latam:
Vez trás vez me he dicho que solo necesito
un poco más de tiempo para superarte.

Original:
But it's been years now.\!
You're still here.
en:
But it's been years now.\!
You're still here.
es-latam:
Pero ya han pasado AÑOS...\!
Y sigues en mi mente, inamovible.

Original: Why did you do this to me?
en: Why did you do this to me?
es-latam:
¿Hasta cuando seguire atado a ti?
¿Por qué me haces esto?

Original: I had a terrible life before I met you.
en: I had a terrible life before I met you.
es-latam: Mi vida era horrible antes de conocerte.

Original:
And you had the audacity to give me hope, before
making it even worse.
en:
And you had the audacity to give me hope, before
making it even worse.
es-latam:
Y de pronto llegaste... y me diste esperanza...\!
solo para arrebatármela y hundirme aún más.

Original:
You acted like you cared.\!
Like you understood me.
en:
You acted like you cared.\!
Like you understood me.
es-latam:
Fingiste que yo te importaba...\!
que me entendías.

Original: I don't think you actually did.
en: I don't think you actually did.
es-latam: Solo me usaste.

Original: You used me.
en: You used me.
es-latam: Y lo peor es que yo te dejé hacerlo.

Original: I hate this feeling.
en: I hate this feeling.
es-latam: Odio este sentimiento, lo aborrezco.

Original:
This emptiness inside of me.\!
I can feel it as if its actually there.
en:
This emptiness inside of me.\!
I can feel it as if its actually there.
es-latam:
Es como si una parte de mí hubiese muerto aquel
día y todavía cargara con su peso.

Original:
I just want to feel something else than this.\.
Anything else.
en:
I just want to feel something else than this.\.
Anything else.
es-latam:
Al principio podía aguantarlo, cargar con él,
pero ahora ya estoy exhausto.

Original: You ruined me, Haven.
en: You ruined me, Haven.
es-latam:
Tú eres la razón de que esté así ahora.
Me has arruinado la vida.

Original: You left a scar on me that never heals.
en: You left a scar on me that never heals.
es-latam: Y no sé cómo salir de esto.

Original: Maybe I should have never met you.
en: Maybe I should have never met you.
es-latam:
Desearía no haberte conocido.
Así no tendría todos estos dolorosos recuerdos.

Original:
I wouldn't have all these memories with you, but
maybe that's for the best.
en:
I wouldn't have all these memories with you, but
maybe that's for the best.
es-latam:
O tal vez sí... no lo sé con certeza.\.
Dicen que todo pasa por una razón.

Name: Haven
Original: Why do you put yourself through this?
en: Why do you put yourself through this?
es-latam: ¿Por qué te obligaste a pasar por todo esto?

Name: Haven
Original:
I did love you.\!
I cared so much about you.
en:
I did love you.\!
I cared so much about you.
es-latam:
¿Es que no lo ves? Yo te amaba.\!
No sabes cuánto me importabas.

Name: Haven
Original: How can you break our trust like that?
en: How can you break our trust like that?
es-latam: ¿Por qué no pudiste confiar en mí?

Name: Haven
Original: I didn’t want to leave you like this.
en: I didn’t want to leave you like this.

Name: Haven
Original:
But you’re hurting yourself more than I actually
did.
en:
But you’re hurting yourself more than I actually
did.

Name: Haven
Original: Don’t you think it’s time to stop blaming me?
en: Don’t you think it’s time to stop blaming me?

Name: Haven
Original: Or maybe,\. it’s time you stop blaming yourself, too.
en: Or maybe,\. it’s time you stop blaming yourself, too.

Original: I don't miss you
en: I don't miss you

Original: I feel the ground begin to shake.
en: I feel the ground begin to shake.

Original:
It’s subtle, but something deep beneath me is
moving.
en:
It’s subtle, but something deep beneath me is
moving.

Original: My legs feel weak.
en: My legs feel weak.

Original:
The ground is shattering.\!
I feel it all breaking.
en:
The ground is shattering.\!
I feel it all breaking.

Original: ...\. It feels right.
en: ...\. It feels right.

Original: She’s still looking at me.
en: She’s still looking at me.

Original: Like she knows what's about to happen.
en: Like she knows what's about to happen.

Original: Like she’s already said goodbye.
en: Like she’s already said goodbye.

Original: Is this what I deserve?
en: Is this what I deserve?

Original: Everything around me is breaking.
en: Everything around me is breaking.

Original: Is it my fault?
en: Is it my fault?

Original: Was I ever supposed to be held responsible?
en: Was I ever supposed to be held responsible?

Name: Haven
Original: You should leave.
en: You should leave.

Original: Haven would take a lot of pictures.
en: Haven would take a lot of pictures.
es-latam: Haven solía tomar un montón de fotos.

Original:
Usually I didn't like being photographed, but
I tried my best for her.
en:
Usually I didn't like being photographed, but
I tried my best for her.
es-latam:
No me gustaba mucho salir en ellas, pero
hacía un esfuerzo para verla feliz.

Original:
These pictures are something I could never forget
about.
en:
These pictures are something I could never forget
about.
es-latam:
Estas fotos son un bonito recuerdo que jamás
olvidaré.

Original: It reminds me of what Haven and I used to have.
en: It reminds me of what Haven and I used to have.
es-latam: Un recuerdo de quienes solíamos ser.

Original:
Even though we'll probably never see each other
again, I can't lose these memories.
en:
Even though we'll probably never see each other
again, I can't lose these memories.
es-latam:
Puede que nunca más nos volvamos a ver, aún así,
no quiero olvidarlas.

Original: I had studied every day leading up to the test.
en: I had studied every day leading up to the test.
es-latam:
Había estado estudiando todos los días antes
del examen.

Original: And I couldn't remember any of it.
en: And I couldn't remember any of it.
es-latam: Y aun así no pude acordarme de nada.

Original:
The pages were filled with unreadable gibberish.\.
I tried rubbing them out, but they stayed.
en:
The pages were filled with unreadable gibberish.\.
I tried rubbing them out, but they stayed.
es-latam:
Las páginas estaban llenas de garabatos ilegibles.\.
Traté de hallarles algún sentido, descifrarlos...

Original: They wouldn't leave me alone.
en: They wouldn't leave me alone.
es-latam: Nada funcionó.

Original:
I spent the whole hour silently paralyzed.
Unable to move.
en:
I spent the whole hour silently paralyzed.
Unable to move.
es-latam:
Estuve una hora sentado frente al examen,
completamente paralizado.

Original: I had a hard time remembering anything.
en: I had a hard time remembering anything.
es-latam: No conseguía recordar nada.

Original: It didn't feel fair.
en: It didn't feel fair.
es-latam: No era justo.

Original: You remember.
en: You remember.
es-latam: Aún lo recuerdas.

Original: The excitement of seeing that email.
en: The excitement of seeing that email.
es-latam: La emoción que sentiste al ver su correo.

Original: The party ...
en: The party ...

Original:
Alcohol.\.
I never liked the stuff.
en:
Alcohol.\.
I never liked the stuff.
es-latam:
Alcohol.\.
Nunca me gustó esa palabra.

Original: I'm not looking for them.
en: I'm not looking for them.

Original: The bird doesn't see you.
en: The bird doesn't see you.
es-latam: El pájaro no te devuelve la mirada.

Original: Jump in?
en: Jump in?
es-latam: ¿Saltar?

Original: You're getting it now.
en: You're getting it now.
es-latam: Ahora lo entiendes.

Original: That doesn't mean this is over.
en: That doesn't mean this is over.
es-latam: Pero eso no significa que esto ha terminado.

Original: All of these moments from the past ...
en: All of these moments from the past ...
es-latam: Todos eses recuerdos...

Original: They showed you something you're afraid of.
en: They showed you something you're afraid of.
es-latam: Te mostraron lo que realmente te asusta.

Original: Something you've had all your life.
en: Something you've had all your life.
es-latam: Algo que ha estado presente en toda tu vida.

Original: Good.
en: Good.
es-latam: Bien.

Original: I don’t think this sheet was made for swimming ...
en: I don’t think this sheet was made for swimming ...

Original: After everything, you're still here.
en: After everything, you're still here.

Original:
You’ve wandered through everything you tried
to forget.
en:
You’ve wandered through everything you tried
to forget.

Original: You didn’t run from them this time.
en: You didn’t run from them this time.

Original: Even when it hurt,\. even when it scared you ...
en: Even when it hurt,\. even when it scared you ...

Original: ... You stayed.
en: ... You stayed.

Original: This place was made from your fear ...
en: This place was made from your fear ...

Original: ...\. But also your hope.
en: ...\. But also your hope.

Original: Not everyone makes it this far, you know.
en: Not everyone makes it this far, you know.

Original:
Most people get lost.\!
They run away.
en:
Most people get lost.\!
They run away.

Original: It's a miracle that you chose to listen.
en: It's a miracle that you chose to listen.

Original:
You won’t forget what you’ve seen here.\|
He will.
en:
You won’t forget what you’ve seen here.\|
He will.

Original:
Even if he might not change, at least we know you
did.
en:
Even if he might not change, at least we know you
did.

Original: You did the best you could.
en: You did the best you could.

Original: At the bottom of everything, you remain.
en: At the bottom of everything, you remain.

Original:
Climb out of the hole you entered from, and open
the door.
en:
Climb out of the hole you entered from, and open
the door.

Original: Thank you, vessel.
en: Thank you, vessel.

Original: You've made it through.
en: You've made it through.

Original: You didn't stop.
en: You didn't stop.

Original: You faced parts of the past, piece by piece.
en: You faced parts of the past, piece by piece.

Original:
You didn't learn to accept everything, but that's
okay.
en:
You didn't learn to accept everything, but that's
okay.

Original: Many people give up before they reach the end.
en: Many people give up before they reach the end.

Original: You almost did, but you chose to keep going.
en: You almost did, but you chose to keep going.

Original:
Even if he might not change, we hope what you did
was enough.
en:
Even if he might not change, we hope what you did
was enough.

Original: You feel like a better person.
en: You feel like a better person.

Original: You’ve changed more than you realize.
en: You’ve changed more than you realize.

Original:
Maybe not completely, but the weight isn't as
heavy as before.
en:
Maybe not completely, but the weight isn't as
heavy as before.

Original:
Even if he might not change, we know you did your
best.
en:
Even if he might not change, we know you did your
best.

Original: Good luck, vessel.
en: Good luck, vessel.

Original: Do you want to climb the rope?
en: Do you want to climb the rope?

Original:
It's a stone etched with a drawing of a man
smoking.
en:
It's a stone etched with a drawing of a man
smoking.
es-latam:
La piedra tiene tallado el dibujo de un
hombre fumando.

Original: It's a stone etched with a drawing of a lighter.
en: It's a stone etched with a drawing of a lighter.
es-latam:
La piedra tiene tallado el dibujo de un
encendedor.

Original: It's a stone etched with a drawing of a joint.
en: It's a stone etched with a drawing of a joint.
es-latam:
La piedra tiene tallado el dibujo de un
cigarrillo.

Original: We tried picking out the most important memories.
en: We tried picking out the most important memories.
es-latam:
Fuimos muy cuidadosos en la selección de
recuerdos.

Original: The ones that made him.
en: The ones that made him.
es-latam: Sobre todo aquellos que realmente lo definieron.

Original:
But those weren't enough to make this world, so
we had to improvise.
en:
But those weren't enough to make this world, so
we had to improvise.
es-latam:
Pero no fue suficiente, así que tuvimos que
improvisar.

Original: A campfire that once burned.
en: A campfire that once burned.
es-latam: Una fogata ya extinguida.

Original: Light it
en: Light it
es-latam: Encender

Original: You feel a warmth you thought was gone.
en: You feel a warmth you thought was gone.
es-latam:
Vuelves a sentir la calidez de sus flamas.
No estaban extintas, apenas dormidas.

Original: I hope you can help him reignite his fire.
en: I hope you can help him reignite his fire.
es-latam:
Espero que puedas ayudarlo a reavivar
las llamas de vivir.

Original:
He’s still doing it, you know.\!
The substances he depends on to keep living.
en:
He’s still doing it, you know.\!
The substances he depends on to keep living.
es-latam:
Aún se aferra a esas sustancias...\! Espera que
lo ayudan a cargar con el peso de vivir.

Original: His soul,\. that fire has faded out.
en: His soul,\. that fire has faded out.
es-latam:
Aquel fuego que había en su interior...\.
se ha ido muriendo.

Original: He’s been rotting away in the safety of his room.
en: He’s been rotting away in the safety of his room.
es-latam:
Ha estado encerrado en su habitación todo este
tiempo... apagandose más y más.

Original: ...\. I hope you can help him reignite his fire.
en: ...\. I hope you can help him reignite his fire.
es-latam:
...\. Espero sinceramente que puedas ayudarlo
a reavivar las llamas de vivir.

Original: It's my lighter.
en: It's my lighter.
es-latam: Es mi encendedor.

Original: The door won't open.
en: The door won't open.
es-latam: No se abre.

Original: A closet is blocking the door.
en: A closet is blocking the door.
es-latam: Un armario está bloqueando la puerta.

Original: A dead plant.
en: A dead plant.
es-latam: Una planta seca.

Original: A painting.
en: A painting.
es-latam: Una pintura.

Original: A fancy chair.
en: A fancy chair.
es-latam: Una silla elegante.

Original: An old lamp,\. not sure if it still works.
en: An old lamp,\. not sure if it still works.

Original: The lamp doesn't work, even with the power on.
en: The lamp doesn't work, even with the power on.

Original: We meet again.
en: We meet again.

Original: This place sure is strange.
en: This place sure is strange.

Original:
It could be worth exploring this area,\. maybe you
could find something.
en:
It could be worth exploring this area,\. maybe you
could find something.

Original:
The door won't open.
Something's blocking it from the other side.
en:
The door won't open.
Something's blocking it from the other side.

Original: A mop.
en: A mop.

Original: A paint bucket.
en: A paint bucket.

Original:
A big closet.\!
It won't open.
en:
A big closet.\!
It won't open.

Original: A coat rack.
en: A coat rack.

Original: You pressed the button.
en: You pressed the button.

Original: It's some sort of electricity box.
en: It's some sort of electricity box.

Original: When was the last time you felt safe?
en: When was the last time you felt safe?

Original: It must have been a while ago.
en: It must have been a while ago.

Original: Funny how you could never feel safe by yourself.
en: Funny how you could never feel safe by yourself.

Original: Maybe,\. just once more,\. you can feel at ease here.
en: Maybe,\. just once more,\. you can feel at ease here.

Original: Someone's been waiting here for a while.
en: Someone's been waiting here for a while.

Original:
I hope you can forget about the past for a second,
and just appreciate this moment.
en:
I hope you can forget about the past for a second,
and just appreciate this moment.

Name: Haven
Original: Take care of yourself, alright?
en: Take care of yourself, alright?

Name: Haven
Original: And don’t forget to smile once in a while.
en: And don’t forget to smile once in a while.

Original: A small nightstand.
en: A small nightstand.

It's a rolling tray.\!
There's papers, tips, and a grinder.

A closet.\.

Original: It's a broken bike.
en: It's a broken bike.

Original: It's a bin.

Original:
It's a bin.\!
There's a piece of paper in here.
en:
It's a bin.\!
There's a piece of paper in here.

Es un cesto de basura.\!
Hay una hoja de papel dentro.

Original: It's a drinking fountain.

Original: It's a plastic bucket.
en: It's a plastic bucket.

Original: A dirty teddy bear.
en: A dirty teddy bear.

Original: There's a backpack under the bench.
en: There's a backpack under the bench.

Original: Hey, I thought you were going to help me?
en: Hey, I thought you were going to help me?
es-latam: Oye, pensé que ibas a ayudarme.

Original: Excuse me, have you seen my parents?
en: Excuse me, have you seen my parents?

Original: I think I've lost them somewhere here ...
en: I think I've lost them somewhere here ...

Original: I’ll help you find them
en: I’ll help you find them

Original: Where could they be?
en: Where could they be?

Original: Oh, thank you.

Original:
I was a bit scared ...\.

en:
I was a bit scared ...\.
What if I couldn't find them?

Estaba muy asustado porque no podía encontrarlos

Original: But I guess I feel safer now.
en: But I guess I feel safer now.
es-latam:
Pero ahora creo que me siento un poco
más tranquilo.

Original: I don’t know ...
en: I don’t know ...
es-latam: No lo sé...

Original: They were just here a moment ago.
en: They were just here a moment ago.
es-latam: Estaban justo aquí hace un momento.

Original: Could you maybe help me look for them?
en: Could you maybe help me look for them?

Original: Okay
en: Okay

Original: Oh! That’s our TV!
en: Oh! That’s our TV!

Original: Why would they throw this out?
en: Why would they throw this out?
es-latam: ¿Por qué la abandonarón aquí?

Original: It's dad's TV.
en: It's dad's TV.

Original: What's this doing here?
en: What's this doing here?
