en: Was everything perfect, just like you wanted?
es-latam:
¿Si sentías que todo era perfecto
y tal como querías?

Original:
Did you spend time with your family?
Play soccer with your friends?
en:
Did you spend time with your family?
Play soccer with your friends?
es-latam:
¿Si pasabas tiempo con tu familia?
¿O preferías jugar fútbol con tus amigos?

Original: Did you feel like you were ...\| complete?
en: Did you feel like you were ...\| complete?
es-latam: ¿Alguna vez te sentiste...\| completo?

Original: ...\| I guess you're not ready to answer that either.
en: ...\| I guess you're not ready to answer that either.
es-latam:
...\| Mmm, parece que tampoco estás listo para
responder esa pregunta.

Original: Come to your senses, and you will find me again.
en: Come to your senses, and you will find me again.
es-latam:
Una vez que recuperes tus sentidos,
me podrás encontrar de nuevo.

Original:
...\| Perhaps there was something more.\|
A sense of emptiness.
en:
...\| Perhaps there was something more.\|
A sense of emptiness.
es-latam:
...\| Tal vez hubo algo más.\|
Un vacío emocional.

Original:
We're giving you a second chance to see what you
couldn't.
en:
We're giving you a second chance to see what you
couldn't.
es-latam:
Vamos a darte otra oportunidad para ver
lo que no pudiste.

Original: I hope you'll have answers by the next time.
en: I hope you'll have answers by the next time.
es-latam:
Espero que tengas las respuestas cuando nos
volvamos a ver.

Original: For now, we have brought you something.
en: For now, we have brought you something.
es-latam: Por ahora, hemos traído algo para ti.

Original: Something to help you look at your past.
en: Something to help you look at your past.
es-latam: Te ayudará a darle un vistazo a tu pasado.

Original: Principal
en: Principal
es-latam: Director

Name: Principal
Original:
This is your principal,\. reminding you that
students are NOT allowed in the teacher's lounge!
en:
This is your principal,\. reminding you that
students are NOT allowed in the teacher's lounge!
es-latam:
Les habla su director.\. Solo quería recordarles
que está PROHIBIDO entrar en la sala de profesores.

Name: Principal
Original: It is clearly locked for a reason.
en: It is clearly locked for a reason.
es-latam:
Si está cerrado es EVIDENTE que no
tienen por qué entrar.

Name: Principal
Original:
And whoever keeps stealing the toilet paper,
please stop. It's getting ridiculous.
en:
And whoever keeps stealing the toilet paper,
please stop. It's getting ridiculous.
es-latam:
Y quien sea que esté robándose el papel sanitario
será sancionado por una semana si es atrapado.

Name: Principal
Original:
And also, whoever's blasting the music in the 
courtyard, could you please turn it down?
en:
And also, whoever's blasting the music in the 
courtyard, could you please turn it down?
es-latam:
Ah, cierto. Hasta aquí escucho esa insoportable
música. Por favor, ¡BAJEN el volumen!

Name: Principal
Original:
This is your principal,\. reminding you that the
vending machine in the teacher's lounge is broken.
en:
This is your principal,\. reminding you that the
vending machine in the teacher's lounge is broken.
es-latam:
Les habla su director.\. La máquina expendedora
de la sala de profesores está malograda.

Name: Principal
Original:
Good job, whoever keeps breaking into the
teacher's lounge, just to buy some soda.
en:
Good job, whoever keeps breaking into the
teacher's lounge, just to buy some soda.
es-latam:
Al parecer alguien insiste en comprar sus
bebidas en donde NO debe.

Name: Principal
Original:
You must have really wanted that soda, because 
you bought too much.
en:
You must have really wanted that soda, because 
you bought too much.
es-latam:
Y parece que tiene cierta preferencia por la
Coca-Cola, ya que arrasó con TODAS las que había.

Name: Principal
Original:
Now that it's broken, maybe you'll leave the 
teacher's lounge alone!
en:
Now that it's broken, maybe you'll leave the 
teacher's lounge alone!
es-latam:
Bueno, ahora que está averiada, ¡quizá dejes
la sala de profesores en paz!

Name: Principal
Original:
This is your principal,\. letting you know that the
repairman we called to fix the machine ...
en:
This is your principal,\. letting you know that the
repairman we called to fix the machine ...
es-latam:
Les habla su director.\. Llamamos a un técnico
para que repare la máquina expendedora y...

Name: Principal
Original:
...\. Seems to have made things worse.\|
Much worse.
en:
...\. Seems to have made things worse.\|
Much worse.
es-latam: ...\. Parece que lo empeoró todo.

Name: Principal
Original:
The machine is now dispensing random items,
including but not limited to: stale crackers,
en:
The machine is now dispensing random items,
including but not limited to: stale crackers,
es-latam:
Ahora está despachando cosas aleatorias como:
galletas rancias,

Name: Principal
Original: Used paper towels ...
en: Used paper towels ...
es-latam: Toallas de papel mojadas...

Name: Principal
Original:
And what appears to be a single sock.\|
We're working on fixing it.
en:
And what appears to be a single sock.\|
We're working on fixing it.
es-latam:
Y lo que parece ser un calcetín izquierdo.\|
Esperamos poder repararla pronto.

Name: Principal
Original:
In the meantime, we ask that you please stop
breaking into the teacher's lounge ...
en:
In the meantime, we ask that you please stop
breaking into the teacher's lounge ...
es-latam:
Mientras tanto, les pedimos gentilmente que
eviten entrar en la sala de profesores...

Name: Principal
Original:
This is your principal,\. letting you know that the
vending machine has disappeared.
en:
This is your principal,\. letting you know that the
vending machine has disappeared.
es-latam:
Les habla su director.\. Queremos informarles
que la máquina expendedora desapareció.

Name: Principal
Original:
No one saw it disappear, it just did.\.
And I think it took the repairman with it ...
en:
No one saw it disappear, it just did.\.
And I think it took the repairman with it ...
es-latam:
Sencillamente se esfumó, y...\.
creo que se llevó al técnico con ella.

Name: Principal
Original: We'll be hosting a funeral later this week.
en: We'll be hosting a funeral later this week.
es-latam:
Bueno, parece que tendremos un funeral esta
semana...

Original: I guess school is done for today.
en: I guess school is done for today.
es-latam: Creo que eso es todo por hoy.

Original: Another day, another horrible memory.
en: Another day, another horrible memory.
es-latam: Un día más, un recuerdo más para atormentarme.

Original: Can you begin to see what is happening here?
en: Can you begin to see what is happening here?
es-latam: ¿Logras percibir qué es lo que está pasando?

Original:
Every failure,\. every time you tried your best,\.
every time you weren't enough.
en:
Every failure,\. every time you tried your best,\.
every time you weren't enough.
es-latam:
Cada fracaso,\. cada esfuerzo,\.
cada vez que no fuiste suficiente.

Original: Do these moments really define who you are?
en: Do these moments really define who you are?
es-latam: ¿Esos momentos realmente definen quien eres?

Original: ...\| They made you a different person.
en: ...\| They made you a different person.
es-latam: ...\| Ellos te convirtieron en alguien diferente.

Original:
...\| You're still free to be someone, regardless
of what you've experienced.
en:
...\| You're still free to be someone, regardless
of what you've experienced.
es-latam:
...\| Aún puedes ser alguien mejor... pese a
lo que hayas vivido.

Original:
I do hope you realize that you don’t have to
hold on to these moments forever.
en:
I do hope you realize that you don’t have to
hold on to these moments forever.
es-latam:
Espero que pronto entiendas que no tienes
porque aferrarte a esos momentos.

Original:
You've made the first step to opening your eyes.\!
Can you understand?
en:
You've made the first step to opening your eyes.\!
Can you understand?
es-latam:
Pero ya has dado los primeros pasos para lograrlo.\!
¿Te diste cuenta?

Original:
You still have time to get accustomed with
these grounds,\. but you're going in a direction.
en:
You still have time to get accustomed with
these grounds,\. but you're going in a direction.
es-latam:
Aún cuentas con tiempo para conocer mejor
el camino que decidiste seguir.

Original: I don't have the power to say which is correct.
en: I don't have the power to say which is correct.
es-latam: No puedo decirte si es o no el correcto.

Original: You still have a long journey ahead of you.
en: You still have a long journey ahead of you.
es-latam: Aún te queda un largo camino por recorrer.

Original: ...\| Do you think you'll be able to keep trying?
en: ...\| Do you think you'll be able to keep trying?
es-latam: ...\| ¿Crees que lograrás seguir?

Original: Yes, I will.
en: Yes, I will.
es-latam: Sí

Original: I don't know.
en: I don't know.
es-latam: No lo sé

Original: You keep looking back, don't you?
en: You keep looking back, don't you?
es-latam: Aún te cuesta dejar ir el pasado, ¿no?

Original:
Staring at those moments like they're still
actually happening.
en:
Staring at those moments like they're still
actually happening.
es-latam:
Revives aquellos momentos una y otra vez en
tu mente.

Original:
You're afraid of something.\!
You're afraid because what if it happens again?
en:
You're afraid of something.\!
You're afraid because what if it happens again?
es-latam:
Te asusta, ¿no?\!
Te asusta que vuelva a pasar.

Original:
Adults are just the older versions of their
younger selves, right?
en:
Adults are just the older versions of their
younger selves, right?
es-latam:
Al final, ¿qué son los adultos sino versiones
mas grandes de sus yo más jóvenes?

Original:
So why wouldn't these things happen again?\!
Am I right?
en:
So why wouldn't these things happen again?\!
Am I right?
es-latam:
Asi que, ¿por qué tendría que pasar de nuevo?\!
¿Verdad?

Original: ...\| I thought so.
en: ...\| I thought so.

Original: ...\| So why do you keep looking back in fear?
en: ...\| So why do you keep looking back in fear?

Original: ...\| Do you think you'll ever stop running?
en: ...\| Do you think you'll ever stop running?

Original: Maybe, but not yet.
en: Maybe, but not yet.

Original: No, they'll always follow.
en: No, they'll always follow.

Original: Do you understand why you're here?
en: Do you understand why you're here?

Original: This opportunity ...
en: This opportunity ...

Original:
It's what you do, isn't it?\!
Pretend it didn't happen.
en:
It's what you do, isn't it?\!
Pretend it didn't happen.

Original:
...\. But the memories are all still here.\.
Waiting to be discovered.
en:
...\. But the memories are all still here.\.
Waiting to be discovered.

Original: Are you scared of what you've experienced?
en: Are you scared of what you've experienced?

Original:
Is the thought of seeing those moments so
horrifying to you?
en:
Is the thought of seeing those moments so
horrifying to you?

Original:
You still have time to get accustomed with
these grounds,\. but you're haven't started.
en:
You still have time to get accustomed with
these grounds,\. but you're haven't started.

Original: I don't have the power to say if this is correct.
en: I don't have the power to say if this is correct.

Original:
...\| Do you really think ignoring it will make
it disappear?
en:
...\| Do you really think ignoring it will make
it disappear?

Original: I can make it go away.
en: I can make it go away.

Original: I don't want to deal with this.
en: I don't want to deal with this.

Original: ...\| You can't forget forever.
en: ...\| You can't forget forever.

Original: I sit at the table and wait for a waiter.
en: I sit at the table and wait for a waiter.

Original: After a minute, they bring some tea.
en: After a minute, they bring some tea.

Original: I take a sip of the tea.
en: I take a sip of the tea.

Original: ...\| it tastes wet.
en: ...\| it tastes wet.

Original: I should probably go eat dinner now.
en: I should probably go eat dinner now.
es-latam: Tal vez debería ir a cenar.

Original: Can you begin to see what it truly means?
en: Can you begin to see what it truly means?
es-latam: ¿Logras percibir lo que eso significa?

Original: Your life here wasn't perfect, but they mattered.
en: Your life here wasn't perfect, but they mattered.
es-latam:
Tu vida no fue perfecta, en lo absoluto,
pero aún así, siempre fueron inportantes.

Original:
Those moments ...\!
They shaped you as a human being.
en:
Those moments ...\!
They shaped you as a human being.
es-latam:
Aquellos momentos...\!
te definieron como persona.

Original:
You're starting to look at these memories with new
eyes.
en:
You're starting to look at these memories with new
eyes.
es-latam: ¿Logras verlos con otros ojos ahora?

Original: A new perspective.
en: A new perspective.
es-latam: ¿Desde una nueva perspectiva?

Original: Do you feel like you're making progress?
en: Do you feel like you're making progress?
es-latam: ¿Sientes que estás progresando?

Original: ...\| You're not the same person you used to be.
en: ...\| You're not the same person you used to be.
es-latam: ...\| Ya no eres el mismo que solías ser.

Original: You can decide if that's a good thing.
en: You can decide if that's a good thing.
es-latam: Y eso puede ser bueno o malo, tu decides.

Original: ...\| At the end, it's not only about making progress.
en: ...\| At the end, it's not only about making progress.
es-latam:
...\| Al fin de cuentas, no solo se trata de lograr
algún cambio o progreso.

Original:
We're just giving you a chance to explore these
memories, what you do with them is your choice.
en:
We're just giving you a chance to explore these
memories, what you do with them is your choice.
es-latam:
Te estamos dado la oportunidad de explorar estos
recuerdos. Lo que hagas con ellos, depende de ti.

Original:
What happened in this house is something you
can't run away from.
en:
What happened in this house is something you
can't run away from.
es-latam:
No se puede huir por siempre de todo lo que
pasó en esta casa.

Original:
... \.But you're not running away.\!
It's a big step you've taken compared to the past.
en:
... \.But you're not running away.\!
It's a big step you've taken compared to the past.
es-latam:
... \.No lo estás haciendo.\!
Y ese es un gran paso que has dado.

Original:
There's still more to uncover.\!
More moments from the past you'll explore.
en:
There's still more to uncover.\!
More moments from the past you'll explore.
es-latam:
Aún tenemos mucho más a explorar.\!
Más recuerdos que deben ser revisitados.

Original: ...\| Can you bear seeing more of the past?
en: ...\| Can you bear seeing more of the past?
es-latam: ...\| ¿Crees que podrás continuar?

Original: I'll try my best
en: I'll try my best
es-latam: Trataré

Original: It's hard
en: It's hard
es-latam: Es difícil

Original: ...\| You should head to the bus stop.
en: ...\| You should head to the bus stop.
es-latam: ...\| Ve hacia la parada de autobús.

Original:
You keep holding on.\!
You're nothing without those memories.
en:
You keep holding on.\!
You're nothing without those memories.
es-latam:
Sí, lo es, pero debes seguir.\!
Tu vida no significa nada sin ellos.

Original:
They'll be lost if you don't revisit them.\!
You're breaking yourself.
en:
They'll be lost if you don't revisit them.\!
You're breaking yourself.

Original:
It's not like it matters anymore.\!
They're already dead.
en:
It's not like it matters anymore.\!
They're already dead.

Original:
You didn't care about how dad crashed his car, or
how mommy stabbed herself to death afterwards.
en:
You didn't care about how dad crashed his car, or
how mommy stabbed herself to death afterwards.

Original: You lied about visiting them and it haunts you.
en: You lied about visiting them and it haunts you.

Original:
These moments are the only way to see them.\!
And they'll haunt you too.
en:
These moments are the only way to see them.\!
And they'll haunt you too.

Original:
... \.But you're not running away.\!
Instead, you're directly interacting with them.
en:
... \.But you're not running away.\!
Instead, you're directly interacting with them.

Original:
You've thought so many times about these times.
And every time you'd defend\., regret,\. and hate it.
en:
You've thought so many times about these times.
And every time you'd defend\., regret,\. and hate it.

Original: The weight you carry will only be heavier.
en: The weight you carry will only be heavier.

Original: I have to look
en: I have to look

Original: I can't handle this anymore
en: I can't handle this anymore

Original: You're ignoring them.
en: You're ignoring them.

Original: You can't bear the fact of facing the past.
en: You can't bear the fact of facing the past.

Original: What would you achieve with this?
en: What would you achieve with this?

Original:
It's not our choice to determine whether you
will get something out of this.
en:
It's not our choice to determine whether you
will get something out of this.

Original: ...\| Maybe you can forget about them.
en: ...\| Maybe you can forget about them.

Original:
Leave it all behind you.\.
Why would you look back if you can't change it?
en:
Leave it all behind you.\.
Why would you look back if you can't change it?

Original:
We gave you the opportunity to change
your mind.
en:
We gave you the opportunity to change
your mind.

Original:
What happened in this house is something you
shouldn't run away from.
en:
What happened in this house is something you
shouldn't run away from.

Original: ... \.And yet, you are.
en: ... \.And yet, you are.

Original: The choice is ultimately yours.
en: The choice is ultimately yours.

Original: I can't
en: I can't

Original: There you are.
en: There you are.
es-latam: Ahí estás.

Original: It wasn’t easy, but you finally came around.
en: It wasn’t easy, but you finally came around.
es-latam: No fue fácil, pero al fin has llegado.

Original:
I wondered if you’d keep running in circles
forever.
en:
I wondered if you’d keep running in circles
forever.
es-latam:
Comenzaba a preguntarme si es que algún día
lograrías romper el ciclo.

Original:
You know this place, even if you don’t
recognize it.
en:
You know this place, even if you don’t
recognize it.
es-latam:
Ya conoces este lugar, aunque pienses que
no es así.

Original: Not just this empty void, but this whole world.
en: Not just this empty void, but this whole world.
es-latam:
No me refiero solamente a este vacío,
sino a TODO este mundo.

Original: It's been growing ever since he was just little.
en: It's been growing ever since he was just little.
es-latam: Ha crecido bastante desde que él era pequeño.

Original: Come on, we've got a lot to walk through.
en: Come on, we've got a lot to walk through.
es-latam:
Ven conmigo, nos espera un largo camino
por delante.

Original:
Throughout the days, you’ve come across
the others.
en:
Throughout the days, you’ve come across
the others.
es-latam: Esta no es la primera vez que nos encontramos.

Original: The Loneliness.
en: The Loneliness.
es-latam: Soy Soledad, así nos llamamos.

Original: Each one of us pulled from the loneliness he felt.
en: Each one of us pulled from the loneliness he felt.
es-latam:
Nos originamos de él... nutridos por cada miedo,
culpa, humillación y resentimiento suyo.

Original:
We've never been able to get in touch with him
directly.
en:
We've never been able to get in touch with him
directly.
es-latam: No podíamos llegar hasta él.

Original: But we had enough power to bring you here.
en: But we had enough power to bring you here.
es-latam:
Pero teníamos suficiente poder para
traerte hacia nosotros... a este mundo.

Original:
This world ...\!
We created it with parts of his memories.
en:
This world ...\!
We created it with parts of his memories.
es-latam:
Todo lo que ves a tu alrededor...\! fue hecho
con partes de sus recuerdos, así lo creamos.

Original: A white sheet he used to hide under.
en: A white sheet he used to hide under.
es-latam: La manta blanca que usaba para esconderse.

Original: Someone who was so important to him.
en: Someone who was so important to him.
es-latam: Aquella persona importante para él.

Original: And a bus stop taking him back home.
en: And a bus stop taking him back home.
es-latam: La parada de autobús al regresar a casa.

Original: We did this for one purpose.
en: We did this for one purpose.
es-latam: Todo esto responde a un propósito.

Original:
To make you,\. and therefore him,\. look at these
memories from a different perspective.
en:
To make you,\. and therefore him,\. look at these
memories from a different perspective.
es-latam:
Ofrecerte a ti,\. y por ende a él también,\.
una nueva perspectiva de estos recuerdos.

Original: To relive the past, and see if you could change.
en: To relive the past, and see if you could change.
es-latam:
Y ver si eras capaz de cambiar al
revivir el pasado.

Original: We believed there was a way out of our bodies.
en: We believed there was a way out of our bodies.
es-latam:
Creía que solo así podríamos
por fin dejar ir estos cuerpos...

Original:
I wanted to move on.\!
All of us did.
en:
I wanted to move on.\!
All of us did.
es-latam: Todos lo creíamos.

Original: The only thing that was stopping us,\. was him.
en: The only thing that was stopping us,\. was him.
es-latam: Pero había un problema:\. él.

Original: His unwillingness to face what he’s left behind.
en: His unwillingness to face what he’s left behind.
es-latam:
No estaba dispuesto a enfrentar aquello que
dejó atrás.

Original: You're not who you think you are.
en: You're not who you think you are.
es-latam: No eres quien piensas que eres.

Original: You're not him.
en: You're not him.
es-latam: No eres él... Y no esperábamos que lo fueras.

Original: You were never meant to be.
en: You were never meant to be.
es-latam: Eres apenas un receptáculo.

Original:
You carry his memories.\!
Everything he's lived through.
en:
You carry his memories.\!
Everything he's lived through.
es-latam:
Posees sus recuerdos.\!
Todas sus experiencias vividas.

Original:
We pulled you out of him, so you could try to
make him accept his past.
en:
We pulled you out of him, so you could try to
make him accept his past.
es-latam:
Te hemos traído aquí para que lo ayudes a
aceptar su pasado.

Original: Look down, into the hole.
en: Look down, into the hole.
es-latam: Asómate hacia el hoyo.

Original:
It’s a tear in our world.\!
A glimpse into the real one.
en:
It’s a tear in our world.\!
A glimpse into the real one.
es-latam:
Mira lo que sucede del otro lado...
en el mundo real.

Original: He’s still in his bed.
en: He’s still in his bed.
es-latam: Aún continua en su habitación, preso de sí mismo.

Original: Soon, we'll have to let you go.
en: Soon, we'll have to let you go.
es-latam: Dentro de poco, tendremos que dejarte ir.

Original:
We're running out of power to keep this
world alive.
en:
We're running out of power to keep this
world alive.
es-latam:
No podemos seguir manteniendo vivo este
mundo por mucho más tiempo.

Original:
You'll open a locked door, and return to
the human world.
en:
You'll open a locked door, and return to
the human world.
es-latam:
Ya va siendo hora de que regreses
al mundo real.

Original:
What you’ve seen here ...\!
Everything you've learned ...
en:
What you’ve seen here ...\!
Everything you've learned ...
es-latam:
Lo que has visto aquí...\!
Lo que has aprendido...

Original: None of it will reach him directly.
en: None of it will reach him directly.
es-latam: Nada de eso trascenderá hacia él.

Original:
When he wakes up, he won’t remember this place.\!
You can't bring your memories to him.
en:
When he wakes up, he won’t remember this place.\!
You can't bring your memories to him.
es-latam:
Al despertar, no recordará este lugar,
ni ninguna experiencia tuya en este mundo.

Original: But maybe ...
en: But maybe ...
es-latam: Pero talvez...

Original:
Maybe he’ll remember the feeling.\!
The feeling of finally being ready to move on.
en:
Maybe he’ll remember the feeling.\!
The feeling of finally being ready to move on.
es-latam:
Talvez recuerde cómo se siente estar listo
para superar el pasado.

Original: ...\| That was our hope.
en: ...\| That was our hope.
es-latam: ...\| Esperamos que sea así.

Original: Do you understand, vessel?
en: Do you understand, vessel?
es-latam: ¿Has comprendido?

Original: There's something you still need to leave.
en: There's something you still need to leave.
es-latam:
Todavía hay algo más de lo que necesitas
desprenderte.

Original: If you're ready,\. put your sheet back on.
en: If you're ready,\. put your sheet back on.
es-latam:
Si crees estar listo,\. colocate de nuevo
la manta blanca.

Name: Haven
Original: You made it.
en: You made it.
es-latam: Ay, ¡al fin llegaste!

Name: Haven
Original: Took you long enough,\. haha.
en: Took you long enough,\. haha.
es-latam: Te tomaste tu tiempo, ¿eh?

Name: Haven
Original: You sound tired ...
en: You sound tired ...
es-latam: Te oyes cansado...

Name: Haven
Original: Are you alright?
en: Are you alright?
es-latam: ¿Todo bien?

Original: I'm alright
en: I'm alright
es-latam: Sí, estoy bien

Original: It's been heavy
en: It's been heavy
es-latam: Ha sido bastante duro

Name: Haven
Original: I see ...
en: I see ...
es-latam: Oh, ya veo...

Name: Haven
Original: I'm sorry to hear that ...
en: I'm sorry to hear that ...

Name: Haven
Original: Well, what's new?
en: Well, what's new?

Original: Nothing's changed
en: Nothing's changed

Original: I don't know where to begin
en: I don't know where to begin

Original: You first
en: You first

Name: Haven
Original:
Are you telling me you're still the same boy
I used to know?
en:
Are you telling me you're still the same boy
I used to know?

Name: Haven
Original: That can't be true! Everyone changes!
en: That can't be true! Everyone changes!

Name: Haven
Original: I think you're just afraid of telling me.
en: I think you're just afraid of telling me.

Name: Haven
Original: Well, we don't have to talk about it right now.
en: Well, we don't have to talk about it right now.

Name: Haven
Original: ...\. You've been through a lot, haven't you?
en: ...\. You've been through a lot, haven't you?

Name: Haven
Original: I've been worried about whether you'd be okay.
en: I've been worried about whether you'd be okay.

Name: Haven
Original: It's okay if you don't want to talk about it.
en: It's okay if you don't want to talk about it.

Name: Haven
Original: Hmmm, let's see ...
en: Hmmm, let's see ...

Name: Haven
Original: Oh! I got into a band!
en: Oh! I got into a band!

Name: Haven
Original:
Bet you remember me trying to teach myself
guitar...\. well, it paid off!
en:
Bet you remember me trying to teach myself
guitar...\. well, it paid off!

Name: Haven
Original: You should come to one of our shows someday!
en: You should come to one of our shows someday!

Name: Haven
Original: Do you still listen to that one band?
en: Do you still listen to that one band?

Name: Haven
Original:
The one with the terrible name but actually
good songs?
en:
The one with the terrible name but actually
good songs?

Original: You mean Stray Kats?
en: You mean Stray Kats?

Original: Probably, I listen to a lot
en: Probably, I listen to a lot

Original: I haven't
en: I haven't

Name: Haven
Original: Yes! \.That’s the one!
en: Yes! \.That’s the one!

Name: Haven
Original:
I've been listening to them again recently.\!
Not sure if you’d still like them ...
en:
I've been listening to them again recently.\!
Not sure if you’d still like them ...

Name: Haven
Original: I guess they remind me of a different time.
en: I guess they remind me of a different time.

Original: They’re still around?
en: They’re still around?

Original: I forgot about them
en: I forgot about them

Name: Haven
Original: Yeah!\. Barely, though.
en: Yeah!\. Barely, though.

Name: Haven
Original:
I think only one of the original members is still
in it.
en:
I think only one of the original members is still
in it.

Name: Haven
Original: Their sound changed a lot, it's more polished.
en: Their sound changed a lot, it's more polished.

Name: Haven
Original:
My favorite will always be the one with the red
album cover though.
en:
My favorite will always be the one with the red
album cover though.

Name: Haven
Original: That’s fair.
en: That’s fair.

Name: Haven
Original: Honestly,\. I kind of did too for a while.
en: Honestly,\. I kind of did too for a while.

Name: Haven
Original: But then one of their songs came on by accident.
en: But then one of their songs came on by accident.

Name: Haven
Original:
Reminded me of when we listened to them
together.
en:
Reminded me of when we listened to them
together.

Name: Haven
Original: Of course you do ...
en: Of course you do ...

Name: Haven
Original:
You always had a bunch of playlists for
every mood.
en:
You always had a bunch of playlists for
every mood.

Name: Haven
Original:
Let me think ...\!
"Rainy and cozy"?
en:
Let me think ...\!
"Rainy and cozy"?

Name: Haven
Original:
Or "empty head"?\!
Or what about "floating music"?
en:
Or "empty head"?\!
Or what about "floating music"?

Original: You liked those playlists
en: You liked those playlists

Original: I deleted them all
en: I deleted them all

Name: Haven
Original: I have to admit, I did listen to them.
en: I have to admit, I did listen to them.

Name: Haven
Original: Especially your crying music playlist, haha.
en: Especially your crying music playlist, haha.

Name: Haven
Original: I think I still have them saved on my phone ...
en: I think I still have them saved on my phone ...

Name: Haven
Original: That's a shame ...
en: That's a shame ...

Name: Haven
Original:
I get it though,\. I do the same everytime I feel
like I have to move on.
en:
I get it though,\. I do the same everytime I feel
like I have to move on.

Name: Haven
Original: So I don't blame you, haha.
en: So I don't blame you, haha.

Name: Haven
Original:
Oh ...\!
I'm just surprised, that's it.
en:
Oh ...\!
I'm just surprised, that's it.

Name: Haven
Original: Music used to mean everything to you.
en: Music used to mean everything to you.

Original: Maybe I'll get back into it
en: Maybe I'll get back into it

Original: I don't miss it
en: I don't miss it

Name: Haven
Original: You should, maybe for one last time.
en: You should, maybe for one last time.

Name: Haven
Original:
Their older albums really bring out this special
vibe ...
en:
Their older albums really bring out this special
vibe ...

Name: Haven
Original:
I think listening to it after so long will
definitely bring back some good times.
en:
I think listening to it after so long will
definitely bring back some good times.

Name: Haven
Original: That’s okay.
en: That’s okay.

Name: Haven
Original: People change.
en: People change.

Name: Haven
Original: Maybe it meant what it needed to at the time.
en: Maybe it meant what it needed to at the time.

Name: Haven
Original:
And maybe something else will take its place
someday.
en:
And maybe something else will take its place
someday.

Name: Haven
Original: There's no way to say, honestly!
en: There's no way to say, honestly!

Name: Haven
Original:
I was up that mountain the other day.\.
You know which one I'm talking about right?
en:
I was up that mountain the other day.\.
You know which one I'm talking about right?

Name: Haven
Original: I was surprised to see our flag was still there.
en: I was surprised to see our flag was still there.

Original: You went back there?
en: You went back there?

Original: I almost forgot about that
en: I almost forgot about that

Name: Haven
Original:
Yeah ...\.
It looked kind of sad now.
en:
Yeah ...\.
It looked kind of sad now.

Name: Haven
Original: But it still made me smile.
en: But it still made me smile.

Name: Haven
Original: I remember how you struggled at some parts!
en: I remember how you struggled at some parts!

Name: Haven
Original: I was proud that we did end up reaching the top.
en: I was proud that we did end up reaching the top.

Name: Haven
Original: Anyways, I sat there for a while.
en: Anyways, I sat there for a while.

Name: Haven
Original: Didn’t really think about anything.
en: Didn’t really think about anything.

Name: Haven
Original: ... Can I say something kinda stupid?
en: ... Can I say something kinda stupid?

Original: Please do
en: Please do

Name: Haven
Original: I'm so proud of you.
en: I'm so proud of you.

Name: Haven
Original: The fact that you're still here means a lot.
en: The fact that you're still here means a lot.

Name: Haven
Original: And I hope you can be proud of yourself too.
en: And I hope you can be proud of yourself too.

Name: Haven
Original:
Just wanted to say that since I don't know
when we'll see each other again.
en:
Just wanted to say that since I don't know
when we'll see each other again.

Name: Haven
Original: Who knows, maybe this would be the last time.
en: Who knows, maybe this would be the last time.

Name: Haven
Original:
You know ...\. maybe it's best that you have
that flag.
en:
You know ...\. maybe it's best that you have
that flag.

Name: Haven
Original: I brought it with me from the mountain.
en: I brought it with me from the mountain.

Name: Haven
Original:
It’s still in my closet.\!
If you want it, it’s yours.
en:
It’s still in my closet.\!
If you want it, it’s yours.

Name: Haven
Original: Maybe it can make you feel safe.
en: Maybe it can make you feel safe.

Name: Haven
Original: I’m really glad we did this.
en: I’m really glad we did this.

Name: Haven
Original: Even if it’s the last time.
en: Even if it’s the last time.

Name: Haven
Original: You can stay here as long as you'd like.
en: You can stay here as long as you'd like.

Name: Haven
Original: And leave whenever you feel ready.
en: And leave whenever you feel ready.

Original:
This looks like one of the drawings I used to make
when I was young.
en:
This looks like one of the drawings I used to make
when I was young.
es-latam:
Se parece a los dibujos que solía hacer de más
joven.

Original:
As a kid, I guess I always felt different from
the other kids.
en:
As a kid, I guess I always felt different from
the other kids.
es-latam:
Yo... siempre me sentí diferente de los otros
niños.

Original:
I didn't feel comfortable getting to know the
others,\. so I'd watch from a distance.
en:
I didn't feel comfortable getting to know the
others,\. so I'd watch from a distance.
es-latam:
No me sentía muy cómodo cerca de otros niños,\.
así que procurava guardar cierta distancia.

Original: While they were having fun, I observed.
en: While they were having fun, I observed.
es-latam:
Me limitaba a observar de lejos cómo
se divertían.

Original: It's another one of my drawings.
en: It's another one of my drawings.
es-latam: Es otro de mis dibujos.

Original:
The other kids always had these cool toys or
trading cards to show off.
en:
The other kids always had these cool toys or
trading cards to show off.
es-latam:
Los otros niños solían presumir las cartas o
las figuras de acción que les habían comprado.

Original:
My parents didn't give me many toys to play with,\.
so I was always fascinated when I saw them.
en:
My parents didn't give me many toys to play with,\.
so I was always fascinated when I saw them.
es-latam:
Mis padres casi nunca me compraban juguetes,\.
así que, en cierta forma, admiraba a esos niños.

Original: Still,\. I was too scared to approach them.
en: Still,\. I was too scared to approach them.
es-latam:
Claro,\. nunca llegaba a acercarme a ellos,
más que todo, por temor.

Original:
It felt kind of weird being the only one 
who didn't talk.
en:
It felt kind of weird being the only one 
who didn't talk.
es-latam:
Se sentía raro ser el unico niño que se
la pasaba callado.

Original:
I imagined myself as some kind of alien.\!
Or maybe an invisible ghost.
en:
I imagined myself as some kind of alien.\!
Or maybe an invisible ghost.
es-latam:
A veces me decía a mi mismo que era como
un fantasma: invisible para los demás.

Original:
One day, I told myself I was going to be friends
with everyone.
en:
One day, I told myself I was going to be friends
with everyone.
es-latam:
Cierto día, me armé de valor y decidí que iba
a pedirles que me aceptaran en su grupo.

Original:
I was finally going to have fun, just like the
other kids.
en:
I was finally going to have fun, just like the
other kids.
es-latam:
Por fin iba a tener amigos con quienes
divertirme y reír juntos.

Original:
...\| But they rejected me.\!
They said I was weird.
en:
...\| But they rejected me.\!
They said I was weird.
es-latam:
...\| Pero me rechazaron.\!
Dijeron que no se juntaban con chicos raros.

Original: Something like “Go away, we don’t want you here.”
en: Something like “Go away, we don’t want you here.”
es-latam:
'Lárgate de aquí, rarito'. Esas fueron
sus palabras exactas.

Original:
Maybe they didn’t like me because I never talked.\!
Maybe I just didn’t fit in.
en:
Maybe they didn’t like me because I never talked.\!
Maybe I just didn’t fit in.
es-latam:
Quizá solo desconfiaban de mí...\!
o quizá nunca les caí bien.

Original: I guess I had accepted that I was too different.
en: I guess I had accepted that I was too different.
es-latam:
Así que solo quedó aceptar que era...
diferente, distinto a ellos.

Original:
Instead of bothering anyone,\. I chose to be on
my own.
en:
Instead of bothering anyone,\. I chose to be on
my own.
es-latam:
Decicí no volver a molestarlos nunca más
y estar por mi cuenta.

Original: Well, it didn't really feel like I had a choice.
en: Well, it didn't really feel like I had a choice.
es-latam:
Bueno, no es que hubiera muchas otras
alternativas.

Original:
I started feeling something new.\!
Something I didn't feel before.
en:
I started feeling something new.\!
Something I didn't feel before.
es-latam:
Comenze a sentir una sensación que hasta
ese entonces, era desconocida para mí.

Original:
I was so sad. It felt like there was something
missing in me.
en:
I was so sad. It felt like there was something
missing in me.
es-latam:
Era una sensación constante de vacío y tristeza.
Más tarde aprendí su nombre: melancolía.

Original:
It felt wrong.\!
I was wrong.
en:
It felt wrong.\!
I was wrong.
es-latam: Me hacía sentir muy mal.

Original:
After a while, I started seeing those other
kids differently.
en:
After a while, I started seeing those other
kids differently.
es-latam:
Al poco tiempo, comenzé a ver a estos niños
con otros ojos.

Original: They didn’t feel like people to me anymore.
en: They didn’t feel like people to me anymore.
es-latam: Se sentían ajenos, distantes...

Original:
They felt wrong,\. unfamiliar.\!
Unrecognizable as one of my own.
en:
They felt wrong,\. unfamiliar.\!
Unrecognizable as one of my own.
es-latam:
Como si fueran una especie completamente
distinta a la humana.

Original: I didn’t want to see them anymore.
en: I didn’t want to see them anymore.
es-latam: No quería volver a verlos.

Original: I was fine on my own.
en: I was fine on my own.
es-latam: Estaba mucho mejor por mi cuenta.

Original: I got used to having to entertain myself.
en: I got used to having to entertain myself.
es-latam:
Incluso fui encontrando diversas formas de
divertirme solo.

Original:
But then, I started seeing more of those shadow
figures.
en:
But then, I started seeing more of those shadow
figures.
es-latam:
Fue durante ese tiempo que comenzé a notar que era
a menudo observado por cierta 'gente sombra'.

Original:
Though this time, they looked different.\!
Tall and slim.
en:
Though this time, they looked different.\!
Tall and slim.
es-latam:
Eran delgados y bastante altos, al menos desde
la perspectiva de un niño.

Original:
They didn’t say much to me, but they didn’t
bother me either.
en:
They didn’t say much to me, but they didn’t
bother me either.
es-latam: Nunca me molestaban, y rara vez decían algo.

Original: They were just there sometimes.
en: They were just there sometimes.
es-latam: Solo... estaban ahí.

Original: I got used to them being around.
en: I got used to them being around.
es-latam: Poco a poco me fui acostumbrando a su compañia.

Original:
I would talk to them, even though they never
responded.
en:
I would talk to them, even though they never
responded.
es-latam:
Trataba de comunicarme con ellos, sin embargo
nunca me respondían.

Original: But that was enough for me.
en: But that was enough for me.
es-latam: Pero eso no me incomodaba en lo absoluto.

Original: I felt connected again.
en: I felt connected again.
es-latam: Pronto, dejé de sentirme tan solo.

Original: Not judged, just understood.
en: Not judged, just understood.
es-latam:
Ya no me sentía juzgado por otros,
sino comprendido, aceptado.

Original: You remember these drawings, don't you?
en: You remember these drawings, don't you?
es-latam: Recuerdas estos dibujos, ¿verdad?

Original:
While the others were having fun, you were
drawing on your own.
en:
While the others were having fun, you were
drawing on your own.
es-latam:
Mientras los demás se divertían, tú estabas
absorto en dibujar.

Original: Kind of like a coping mechanism.
en: Kind of like a coping mechanism.
es-latam: Era la forma que tenías de lidiar con tu realidad.

Original:
You hear all those kids?\!
Laughing, running, shouting ...
en:
You hear all those kids?\!
Laughing, running, shouting ...
es-latam:
¿Logras escuchar eso?\!
Son niños riendo, jugando, divirtiendose...

Original:
You were so disconneced from them.\!
You were so different.
en:
You were so disconneced from them.\!
You were so different.
es-latam:
Nunca lograste conectar con ellos por
ser diferente.

Original: That loneliness ...
en: That loneliness ...
es-latam: Tu soledad...

Original: ... it made me.
en: ... it made me.
es-latam: ... nos trajo a la vida.

Original: You remember it, don’t you?
en: You remember it, don’t you?
es-latam: Te acuerdas, ¿no es así?

Original: I didn’t show up one day out of nowhere.
en: I didn’t show up one day out of nowhere.
es-latam: No aparecimos de la nada.

Original: At first, it was just a feeling.
en: At first, it was just a feeling.
es-latam: Todo empezó como una simple sensación.

Original: You didn't feel safe around these people.
en: You didn't feel safe around these people.
es-latam: No te sentías seguro al estar rodeado por otros.

Original: You were alone.
en: You were alone.
es-latam: Querías sentirte solo.

Original:
So you kept to yourself.\!
And quietly, something began to grow from inside.
en:
So you kept to yourself.\!
And quietly, something began to grow from inside.
es-latam:
Así que decidiste aislarte.\! Fue entonces
cuando algo comenzó a crecer en tu interior.

Original: You couldn't see it, but you felt it.
en: You couldn't see it, but you felt it.
es-latam:
No conseguías verlo, pero estaba allí;
podías sentirlo.

Original: Over time, that loneliness became something else.
en: Over time, that loneliness became something else.
es-latam:
Con el paso del tiempo, esa soledad inicial
se fue transformando en algo más.

Original: It only grew stronger and stronger.
en: It only grew stronger and stronger.
es-latam: Se fue haciendo cada vez más fuerte.

Original: All that dark energy coming together.
en: All that dark energy coming together.
es-latam: Toda esa energía negativa... acumulandose.

Original: It formed me.
en: It formed me.
es-latam: Me dio forma.

Original: I became alive.
en: I became alive.
es-latam: Me dio vida.

Original: I didn’t ask to exist.
en: I didn’t ask to exist.
es-latam: No pedí existir.

Original: But you made space for me... \!and I filled that.
en: But you made space for me ... \!and I filled that.
es-latam:
Pero era inevitable que sucediera...\!
Todo vacío siempre será llenado con algo.

Original: And even now,\. after all this time ...
en: And even now,\. after all this time ...
es-latam: Incluso ahora,\. después de todos estos años...

Original: I’m still here.
en: I’m still here.
es-latam: Aún continuo existiendo.

Original: Because that loneliness never really went away.
en: Because that loneliness never really went away.
es-latam: Nunca dejé de formar parte de ti.

Original: I hope you can change that.
en: I hope you can change that.
es-latam: Espero que seas capaz de cambiar de eso.

Original: Here's my last attempt to help you.
en: Here's my last attempt to help you.
es-latam: Esta será la última vez que intente ayudarte.

Original:
There's something you need under one of the 
benches.
en:
There's something you need under one of the 
benches.
es-latam:
Ve hacia el banco de madera y busca lo que hay
debajo de él.

Original: You should be able to find it.
en: You should be able to find it.
es-latam: Vas a necesitarlo.

Original: They can't have gone that far, right?
en: They can't have gone that far, right?
es-latam: No creo que hayan ido muy lejos.

Original: I was with them just a moment ago ...
en: I was with them just a moment ago ...
es-latam: Estaban junto conmigo hace unos instantes...

Original: I don’t understand why they had to leave.
en: I don’t understand why they had to leave.
es-latam: No entiendo por qué se fueron.

Original: Does it have something to do with me?
en: Does it have something to do with me?
es-latam: ¿Tendré algo que ver con eso?

Original: Do you think they’ll be waiting for me at home?
en: Do you think they’ll be waiting for me at home?
es-latam: ¿Crees que estén en casa esperando por mí?

Original: They would probably be worried ...
en: They would probably be worried ...
es-latam: Probablemente estén preocupados...

Original: ...\. Or maybe not.
en: ...\. Or maybe not.

Original: It's so cold here ...
en: It's so cold here ...
es-latam: Hace mucho frío aquí...

Original: I don't like this ...
en: I don't like this ...
es-latam: No me gusta nada de esto...

Original:
Maybe if I find all the things they left behind,\.
they’ll come back?
en:
Maybe if I find all the things they left behind,\.
they’ll come back?

Original:
What other reason could they have for throwing
everything out?
en:
What other reason could they have for throwing
everything out?

Original: Oh, there's my house!
en: Oh, there's my house!

Original: Do you think they’ll be mad that I left?
en: Do you think they’ll be mad that I left?

Original: You’ll stay close, right?
en: You’ll stay close, right?

Name: Mr. Lee
Original:
\etalk[4]Hey! Stop doing that!
You're ruining my detention!
en:
\etalk[4]Hey! Stop doing that!
You're ruining my detention!

Name: Pembleton
Original:
\etalk[6]Young man!
Stop that this instant!
en:
\etalk[6]Young man!
Stop that this instant!

Name: Kyle
Original: Hey, could you not?
en: Hey, could you not?

Name: The Twins
Original: \etalk[5]Hell yeah!
en: \etalk[5]Hell yeah!

Name: Trumpeter
Original: Huh? Is that my trumpet?
en: Huh? Is that my trumpet?
es-latam: ¡Mi trompeta!

Name: Librarian
Original: \etalk[6]Excuse me, could you please stop that?
en: \etalk[6]Excuse me, could you please stop that?

Name: Librarian
Original: \etalk[6]There are people trying to read in peace!
en: \etalk[6]There are people trying to read in peace!

Original: You think diving deeper makes you brave?
en: You think diving deeper makes you brave?

Original:
Looking back at these memories, just to hurt
yourself again and again ...
en:
Looking back at these memories, just to hurt
yourself again and again ...

Original: You think that's brave?
en: You think that's brave?

Original: Do you think this is helping?
en: Do you think this is helping?

Original: Then again, you're not doing this to help anyone.
en: Then again, you're not doing this to help anyone.

Original:
There's something in you that wants to feel
broken.
en:
There's something in you that wants to feel
broken.

Original: This isn't the reason we made this world.
en: This isn't the reason we made this world.

Original: We had a purpose.
en: We had a purpose.

Original:
...\. But fine.\!
You want to see how far it goes?
en:
...\. But fine.\!
You want to see how far it goes?

Original: I’ll walk with you.
en: I’ll walk with you.

Original: I always do.
en: I always do.

Original: That was foolish of us.
en: That was foolish of us.

Original: We had hoped too much.
en: We had hoped too much.

Original: To think he could change?\! That you could change?
en: To think he could change?\! That you could change?

Original: You're rotten.
en: You're rotten.

Original: I guess the past does define who you become.
